import sys, io, contextlib, re
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, '/data/scripts')
import crawl_mottruyentrung as cm

params = _items[0]['json']
slug = params.get('slug') or cm.DEFAULT_SLUG
out_dir = Path('/data/crawl-output') / (params.get('out_subdir') or slug)
delay = float(params.get('delay') or 1.0)
limit_raw = params.get('limit')
limit = int(limit_raw) if limit_raw and int(limit_raw) > 0 else None

buf = io.StringIO()
try:
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf), contextlib.redirect_stderr(buf):
        cm.crawl(slug, out_dir, delay, limit)
    error = None
except Exception as exc:
    error = f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'

log = buf.getvalue()
total_match = re.search(r'Tìm thấy (\d+) chương', log)
crawled = len(re.findall(r'^\[>\] ', log, flags=re.M))
skipped = len(re.findall(r'^\[=\] ', log, flags=re.M))
failed = len(re.findall(r'^\s*! Lỗi:', log, flags=re.M))
combined_match = re.search(r'File gộp: (.+)', log)

return [{
    'json': {
        'success': error is None,
        'error': error,
        'slug': slug,
        'out_dir': str(out_dir),
        'total_chapters': int(total_match.group(1)) if total_match else None,
        'crawled_now': crawled,
        'skipped_existing': skipped,
        'failed': failed,
        'combined_file': combined_match.group(1).strip() if combined_match else None,
        'log_tail': log[-2000:],
    }
}]

import os, re, sys, hmac, hashlib, datetime, unicodedata, urllib.request, urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse

sys.path.insert(0, '/data/scripts')
import crawl_mottruyentrung as cm

prev = _items[0]['json']
if not prev.get('success'):
    return [{'json': {'success': False, 'error': 'crawler did not succeed', 'crawler_result': prev}}]

slug = prev['slug']
out_dir = Path(prev['out_dir'])

def vn_slug(s):
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', s)
    s = ''.join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    s = s.replace('đ', 'd').replace('Đ', 'D').lower()
    s = re.sub(r'\s+', '-', s.strip())
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9\-_.]', '', s)
    s = re.sub(r'-+', '-', s).strip('-.')
    return s

title = slug
try:
    main_html = cm.http_request(f'{cm.BASE_URL}/manga/{slug}/')
    m = re.search(r'<meta\s+property="og:title"[^>]*content="([^"]+)"', main_html, re.I)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
except Exception:
    pass

folder = vn_slug(title) or slug

endpoint = os.environ.get('MINIO_ENDPOINT', 'http://minio:9000')
access_key = os.environ['MINIO_ACCESS_KEY']
secret_key = os.environ['MINIO_SECRET_KEY']
bucket = os.environ.get('MINIO_BUCKET', 'mottruyen')
region = os.environ.get('MINIO_REGION', 'us-east-1')

def s3_put(key, body, content_type):
    parsed = urlparse(endpoint)
    host = parsed.netloc
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC)
    amzdate = now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
    datestamp = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    payload_hash = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
    canonical_uri = '/' + bucket + '/' + urllib.parse.quote(key, safe='/')
    canonical_headers = f'host:{host}\nx-amz-content-sha256:{payload_hash}\nx-amz-date:{amzdate}\n'
    signed_headers = 'host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date'
    canonical_request = f'PUT\n{canonical_uri}\n\n{canonical_headers}\n{signed_headers}\n{payload_hash}'
    algorithm = 'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256'
    credential_scope = f'{datestamp}/{region}/s3/aws4_request'
    string_to_sign = f'{algorithm}\n{amzdate}\n{credential_scope}\n{hashlib.sha256(canonical_request.encode()).hexdigest()}'
    def _sign(k, m):
        return hmac.new(k, m.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    k_date = _sign(('AWS4' + secret_key).encode(), datestamp)
    k_region = _sign(k_date, region)
    k_service = _sign(k_region, 's3')
    k_signing = _sign(k_service, 'aws4_request')
    signature = hmac.new(k_signing, string_to_sign.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    auth = f'{algorithm} Credential={access_key}/{credential_scope}, SignedHeaders={signed_headers}, Signature={signature}'
    url = f'{endpoint}{canonical_uri}'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method='PUT', headers={
        'Host': host, 'X-Amz-Date': amzdate, 'X-Amz-Content-SHA256': payload_hash,
        'Authorization': auth, 'Content-Type': content_type,
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
        return resp.status

uploaded = []
errors = []
for f in sorted(out_dir.glob('*.txt')):
    body = f.read_bytes()
    key = f'{folder}/{f.name}'
    try:
        status = s3_put(key, body, 'text/plain; charset=utf-8')
        uploaded.append({'key': key, 'size': len(body), 'status': status})
    except Exception as e:
        errors.append({'file': f.name, 'error': f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'})

return [{
    'json': {
        'success': len(errors) == 0 and len(uploaded) > 0,
        'slug': slug,
        'title': title,
        'folder': folder,
        'out_dir': str(out_dir),
        'bucket': bucket,
        'endpoint': endpoint,
        'uploaded_count': len(uploaded),
        'failed_count': len(errors),
        'uploaded': uploaded,
        'errors': errors,
    }
}]

import os, re, json, hmac, hashlib, datetime, urllib.request, urllib.parse
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse

prev = _items[0]['json']
if not prev.get('success'):
    return [{'json': {'success': False, 'error': 'upload step did not succeed', 'upload_result': prev}}]

slug = prev.get('slug')
folder = prev['folder']
out_dir = Path(prev['out_dir'])

vllm_url = os.environ.get('VLLM_BASE_URL', 'http://vllm:8000/v1').rstrip('/') + '/chat/completions'
vllm_key = os.environ.get('VLLM_API_KEY', 'vllm-local')
model = os.environ.get('VLLM_MODEL', 'gpt-oss-20b')

endpoint = os.environ.get('MINIO_ENDPOINT', 'http://minio:9000')
access_key = os.environ['MINIO_ACCESS_KEY']
secret_key = os.environ['MINIO_SECRET_KEY']
bucket = 'mottruyen-refactored'
region = os.environ.get('MINIO_REGION', 'us-east-1')

cache_dir = out_dir / '_refactored'
cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def call_vllm(text, reasoning='low'):
    prompt = text + '\n\nchỉnh sửa lỗi chính tả của đoạn văn trên, chỉ trả về văn bản đã sửa, giữ nguyên định dạng và xuống dòng, không thêm giải thích.'
    body = json.dumps({
        'model': model,
        'messages': [{'role': 'user', 'content': prompt}],
        'temperature': 0.1,
        'max_tokens': 32768,
        'chat_template_kwargs': {'reasoning_effort': reasoning},
    }).encode('utf-8')
    req = urllib.request.Request(vllm_url, data=body, method='POST', headers={
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Authorization': f'Bearer {vllm_key}',
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=900) as r:
        d = json.loads(r.read())
    choice = d['choices'][0]
    return (choice['message'].get('content') or '').strip(), choice.get('finish_reason')

def s3_put(key, body, content_type):
    parsed = urlparse(endpoint); host = parsed.netloc
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.UTC)
    amzdate = now.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ'); datestamp = now.strftime('%Y%m%d')
    payload_hash = hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()
    canonical_uri = '/' + bucket + '/' + urllib.parse.quote(key, safe='/')
    canonical_headers = f'host:{host}\nx-amz-content-sha256:{payload_hash}\nx-amz-date:{amzdate}\n'
    signed_headers = 'host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date'
    canonical_request = f'PUT\n{canonical_uri}\n\n{canonical_headers}\n{signed_headers}\n{payload_hash}'
    algorithm = 'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256'
    credential_scope = f'{datestamp}/{region}/s3/aws4_request'
    string_to_sign = f'{algorithm}\n{amzdate}\n{credential_scope}\n{hashlib.sha256(canonical_request.encode()).hexdigest()}'
    def _sign(k, m):
        return hmac.new(k, m.encode(), hashlib.sha256).digest()
    k_date = _sign(('AWS4' + secret_key).encode(), datestamp)
    k_region = _sign(k_date, region); k_service = _sign(k_region, 's3'); k_signing = _sign(k_service, 'aws4_request')
    signature = hmac.new(k_signing, string_to_sign.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    auth = f'{algorithm} Credential={access_key}/{credential_scope}, SignedHeaders={signed_headers}, Signature={signature}'
    url = f'{endpoint}{canonical_uri}'
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method='PUT', headers={
        'Host': host, 'X-Amz-Date': amzdate, 'X-Amz-Content-SHA256': payload_hash,
        'Authorization': auth, 'Content-Type': content_type,
    })
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
        return resp.status

chapter_files = sorted([f for f in out_dir.glob('*.txt') if re.match(r'^\d{3}-', f.name)])
refactored = []
errors = []
combined_parts = []

for f in chapter_files:
    raw = f.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    cache_path = cache_dir / f.name
    if cache_path.exists() and cache_path.stat().st_size > 0:
        new_text = cache_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        cached = True
    else:
        new_text = ''
        last_finish = None
        vllm_exc = None
        try:
            for attempt_reasoning in ('low', 'medium'):
                new_text, last_finish = call_vllm(raw, reasoning=attempt_reasoning)
                if new_text:
                    break
        except Exception as e:
            vllm_exc = f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'
        if not new_text:
            reason = vllm_exc if vllm_exc else f'empty after retry (finish={last_finish})'
            errors.append({'file': f.name, 'stage': 'vllm-fallback', 'error': f'{reason}; using original'})
            new_text = raw
            cache_path.write_text(new_text, encoding='utf-8')
            cache_path.with_suffix('.fallback').touch()
            cached = False
        else:
            cache_path.write_text(new_text, encoding='utf-8')
            cached = False
    body = new_text.encode('utf-8')
    key = f'{folder}/{f.name}'
    try:
        status = s3_put(key, body, 'text/plain; charset=utf-8')
        refactored.append({'key': key, 'size': len(body), 'cached': cached, 'status': status})
        combined_parts.append(new_text)
    except Exception as e:
        errors.append({'file': f.name, 'stage': 's3', 'error': f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'})

if combined_parts:
    combined_text = ''
    for part in combined_parts:
        lines = part.split('\n', 1)
        head = lines[0].lstrip('# ').strip() if lines else ''
        body_text = lines[1].strip() if len(lines) > 1 else ''
        combined_text += f'\n\n====== {head} ======\n\n{body_text}\n'
    combined_filename = f'{slug or folder}_full.txt'
    body = combined_text.encode('utf-8')
    key = f'{folder}/{combined_filename}'
    try:
        status = s3_put(key, body, 'text/plain; charset=utf-8')
        refactored.append({'key': key, 'size': len(body), 'combined': True, 'status': status})
    except Exception as e:
        errors.append({'file': combined_filename, 'stage': 's3', 'error': f'{type(e).__name__}: {e}'})

return [{
    'json': {
        'success': len(errors) == 0 and len(refactored) > 0,
        'folder': folder,
        'bucket': bucket,
        'model': model,
        'refactored_count': len(refactored),
        'failed_count': len(errors),
        'refactored': refactored,
        'errors': errors,
    }
}]
